title: Graph and Lakehouse, Friends at Last
summary: A hands-on walkthrough of Neo4j’s Virtual Graph, then in private preview: a graph model laid over Databricks tables (TPC-H in the example) without copying them, where Cypher is translated deterministically into SQL that runs on Databricks compute under Unity Catalog permissions, and `EXPLAIN` shows the generated SQL. Useful for its worked queries and its honest list of current limits (single-column node IDs, unique relationship types, memory limits on big aggregations); it is a Neo4j post about a Neo4j product and has no performance numbers.
